title: Merge the removal; the canary cluster stops evaluating demo-legacy-profile
notes: The prepared pull request is merged and tagged v005. Main no longer references demo-legacy-profile.
Only the canary cluster redeploys onto it. The other four stay on v004 and keep evaluating the flag, which is what a staged rollout of a code removal actually looks like.
The no-evaluations clock does not start here. It starts when the last cluster stops, and any cluster left behind on v004 keeps resetting it.

Staging takes v005 in the same step as the merge, before any Production cluster expands beyond the canary. That is the order a real release goes in, and it means Staging stops evaluating demo-legacy-profile first rather than having been dark all along.
Both critical environments are now genuinely in the drain: Staging by deployment, Production one cluster at a time.
Eight evaluators, reduced at s028 after the connection burn at fifteen. The ladder is unaffected: every Production cluster and Staging is still its own evaluator.
